table.name: TLGNC_RFIDOBJECT
table.description: The physical object (silo, truck, container, ...) which can be identified by one or several RFID tags. Table is a proxy table between the actual object and a single RFID tag (sticker) and allows for 1:N relationship for all RFID usages. The object itself typically also carries a label, a human readable identifier.

column.name: RFIDOBJECT_TYPE_CD
column.description: Denotes the type of the physical object where RFID tags are placed. Used for building nice UI screens, allowing quick filtering by truck-RFID, silo-RFID etc. Examples: PDA User, Loadingpoint Silo, Parallel Terminal, Truck, Trailer, ...

column.name: OBJECT_LABEL
column.description: External identification of the Object (per rfidobject_type), typically written on a sticker or label. Examples: Inventory numbers of trucks, serial numbers of PDA devices. Logon does not use them as identifiers, but sends them via PDA interface to support RFID administration.
